name: Godrej Parkshire
description: Godrej Parkshire is a high-rise apartment project on the Whitefield-Hoskote corridor, near Old Madras Road. It offers 2, 3, and 3.5 BHK homes, with a landscape built around an elevated greenscape skywalk and five themed activity circles.
curation: An elevated greenscape skywalk winds through the central landscape
Five themed zones: the Social, Senior, Junior, Evergreen, and Active Circles
About 7 mins to Old Madras Road and 16 mins to Hoskote Industrial Area
connectivity: About 7 mins to Old Madras Road
About 8 mins to Delhi Public School
About 12 mins to Orion Uptown Mall
About 22 mins to Whitefield Metro Station
About 40 mins to Kempegowda International Airport
developerNote: Established in 1990, Godrej Properties is the first real estate company in India to have ISO certification, and is currently developing landmark projects across 15+ cities covering over 21.7 million square metres.
photoDescription: Two residential towers at dusk beside a landscaped road
